title: Kattai Panther
style: Phonk-inflected South Indian comedy track with mid-tempo swing and sneaky dembow-leaning bounce; verse rides mridangam taps, clap snaps, and bass slides, pre-chorus strips to beatbox, hand percussion, and filtered harmony, chorus hits with chanty gang vocals, jaw harp accents, and playful call-and-response. Male lead with stacked backing singers, ad-lib panning, harmony lifts, tape-stop flips, temple bell chimes, dusty but punchy low end., comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Oru step, two step, my kattai swagger
I came for dosa, left with a badge and a blazer
Aunty looked once, said “dei, who is this panther?”
I said “bro, I’m local” (local!) “with a Spanish answer”

Beatbox in the corner, tuk-tuk in my mouth
Sambar on my sleeve and I still went south
I tried to look tough, but the filter got silly
My friends all laughed (ha ha) and called me “kili”

[Pre-Chorus]
Sneak, sneak, slide
Nobody catch my pride
Beat goes low, I glide
Ay, ay, ahí, inside

[Chorus]
Kattai panther, kattai panther
Move so sly, move so sly
Kattai panther, kattai panther
One more grin, one more lie

Kattai panther (hey)
Kattai panther (olé)
Kattai panther
I’m gone before you say

[Verse 2]
Tea stall judge in a white veshti shining
He saw my dance and started just miming
I gave him a wink, he said “what a disaster”
Then dropped a beatbox (boom) like a schoolmaster

My cousin said “why you talk like that, macha?”
I said “porque” and he nearly dropped his kacha
Rickshaw man laughed, “dei, this boy is crazy”
I bowed like a star (tch) and stayed real lazy

[Pre-Chorus]
Sneak, sneak, slide
Little joke, big pride
Beat goes low, we ride
Ay, ay, ahí, inside

[Chorus]
Kattai panther, kattai panther
Move so sly, move so sly
Kattai panther, kattai panther
One more grin, one more lie

Kattai panther (hey)
Kattai panther (olé)
Kattai panther
I’m gone before you say

[Bridge]
[Beatbox Break]
K-tha, k-tha, pa-pa-panther
I slipped past the gossips, past the scanner
Mother says “come eat,” I vanish, then answer
With a mouthful of banter (mmm) and a drumline stammer

[Chorus]
Kattai panther, kattai panther
Move so sly, move so sly
Kattai panther, kattai panther
One more grin, one more lie

Kattai panther (hey)
Kattai panther (olé)
Kattai panther
I’m gone before you say
